model_type: between groups t-tests on drug-placebo difference scores

instructions: Subjects were told they would receive doxapram and saline on separate days, that doxapram has a high rate of producing panic attacks in patients with PD, and were instructed to rest quietly.

7UUEcYwZoxRx.name: C. Greater activations for verbal fluency than for counting

clinical_characteristics: Epilepsy began at age 6; one to two seizures daily at surgery. One year after surgery the patient was seizure-free while still treated with drugs.

steps: Stereotactic normalization to standard MNI space using the SPM99 EPI template
Proportional scaling to compensate global signal differences

model_type: Statistical parametric maps of the t values

stimuli: A letter called out loud immediately before the first scan
instructions: Generate words covertly; mentally count from 1 to 10; perform sequential finger oppositions; during rest empty the mind and avoid inner speech.
performance_measures: Words generated during verbal fluency, recalled after the experiment

7VbYtnwdnMKD.name: Linear decreases in BOLD signal with disease duration

diagnostic_instrument: medical history and standard clinical examination
clinical_characteristics: Disease duration 10.0 ± 7.3 years, range 2–25 years. ADDS 58.1 ± 15.5%, range 17.1–77.1%. No dystonia at rest. Fourteen patients had previously received botulinum toxin injections and were studied at least 3 months after the last injection, with drug effects fully worn off.

steps: Realign all scans to the first scan of the first session
Spatially normalize to a standard echo-planar imaging template
Spatial smoothing with an isotropic Gaussian kernel

model_type: general linear model using multiple regression analysis
hrf_model: Delta functions convolved with a haemodynamic response function

stimuli: Johnson-Van Boven-Phillips domes with 0.35-mm and 3.0-mm gaps
Visual warning cue and response cue
Auditory tone indicating stimulus onset and duration
instructions: Keep eyes open and fixate a central cross; rest during rest epochs. Judge grating orientation after the fifth stimulus by pressing a button with the left index finger for smooth surface, middle finger for vertical orientation, or ring finger for horizontal orientation, within 2 seconds.
